item.title: Trump Backs Credit Card Swipe Fee Crackdown—Why Rewards Get Cut and Fees Go Up
item.description: Trump has now endorsed the Durbin-Marshall swipe fee bill, pitching it as “competition” and consumer relief. In reality it shifts value from cardholders to retailers—cutting rewards, pushing issuers toward higher fees elsewhere, and shrinking credit availability—without any reason to expect lower prices.
